title: aster alpinus subsp. subvillosus
intro: Aster alpinus subsp. subvillosus, commonly known as alpine aster, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, aiding in the treatment of various ailments. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support the immune system, making it a valuable addition to traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents present in alpine aster include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
